objective: The retired seed/IA doctrine asserts itself nowhere in tracked canon, and the claim set that judges it is derived from the terminal artifacts rather than hand-written. Re-scoped from the gitignored prompt corpus to the tracked population, because a check over a path CI cannot see would pass vacuously.
falsifiable_claim: The five terminal artifacts exist, parse, and reconcile their declared totals against the collections they declare them over. No tracked canon document asserts any of the three retired clauses — capture-root is the app, landing state is the done-bar, a shell-clean capture is a blocker — as current truth, while a document narrating one as retired is not counted. The retirement itself is still on record at the site the predicate is read from. The subroute census falsifies clause 1 by construction. Every intra-repo path a tracked canon document references resolves. The three surviving seed gates key on the successor artifacts and on none of the retired clauses.

code_anchors.literal: captured reference ROOT is not the application
a check whose evidence cannot contradict the claim it polices is not evidence

adversarial_or_fault_proof: Five drills, one of which is the important one: the retired-clause finding must NOT fire on a document narrating the clause as retired, or the only way to pass would be to delete the history. The others plant an assertion of two clauses at once, a reference to a file that does not exist, a gate keying on a retired clause, and a missing terminal artifact. The check also carries its own falsifiability requirement as an assertion rather than a comment: the subroute census must record in-app routes beyond the workspace root, because that is precisely what clause 1 denies, and evidence that cannot contradict the claim it polices is not evidence.
remaining_nonclaims: The gitignored corpus is NOT policed. internal-docs/prompts/, internal-docs/implementation/ and internal-docs/reverse-engineering/ carry the 287 surface briefs, the retired-doctrine banners and all eleven surviving dangling master-guide pointers, and none of it is tracked. Its sweep is recorded in reference-remediation-ledger.v1.json DOC-1 (2026-08-20) and 286 of the 287 briefs already carry the archival banner; repairing the remaining pointers is hygiene a gate cannot witness.

The retired doctrine is a finite predicate of THREE clauses, not a vocabulary. The words seed and parity remain live and correct: the same ruling keeps parity matrices and pixel certifications in force as evidence. A check that swept the vocabulary would call the successor a residual.

The clause patterns match claim SHAPE. A document asserting the retired doctrine in wording no pattern anticipates would not be caught; the patterns are stated in the check rather than hidden, so widening them is a visible edit.
